messages:
people-ops-bot: Heads-up — Oliver's bday is Thurs Jun 10. Quick poll: 1) Office tea + mini cupcakes at 3pm, 2) Ship curated mug + tea sachets to remote folks, 3) Surprise Slack card + short video montage. React with :one:, :two:, or :three:, or reply. RSVP by Tue noon.
harriet (People Ops): note — mugs can be personalized with names if we have time. Shipping takes 48-72h so please DM addresses if you pick #2. Also mention allergies (nuts/dairy/gluten).
oliver: wow thanks!! low-key please. i'm terrible on camera so maybe skip the montage. :sweat_smile: whatever's easiest.
zara: :two: I like the mug option. also can we do a reusable bamboo straw in the package? eco-friendly is :green_heart:.
emily: :one: I'll be in-office that day and can set up. happy to grab GF cupcakes.
marco: :three: i can make a 30s montage with quick clips from folks. oliver if you prefer no montage we can just do the e-card.
oliver: thanks marco — e-card only sounds great. appreciate the thought tho.
harriet (People Ops): got it — leaning towards mugs + tea unless majority prefers in-office. form: https://forms.gle/oliver-bday-options — choose 1/2/3, dietary notes, or DM for shipping. Closing Tue 12:00 PT.
zara: noted nut-free and no dairy for me (allergic).
emily: volunteering to help set up at 2:45pm if we do office treat.
people-ops-bot: Event placeholder created: "Oliver birthday — treats". Calendar invite will be sent if in-office option wins.
harriet (People Ops): tiny reminder — if you pick shipping, add full mailing address on the form. if you pick mug personalization, include the preferred short name (max 12 chars). final note: no balloons due to office restrictions.
oliver: you guys are the best  thank you <3
harriet (People Ops): will post results after poll closes. please keep replies short so we don't clog the channel. :confetti_ball:
